social.author: Hulk Smash Szn
social.text: 5% to 43% and the game hasn't even scored a point?? Something just happened and I'm choosing to believe it's good. Let's GO No Banner only HULK

social.author: Dawgs Kennel Club
social.text: Kai's win chance just got mugged in broad daylight at 0-0. Someone check the Dawgs' pulse.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: No Banner only HULK jumping from 5% to 43% before a single point is a big lineup-status swing. Still short of a coin flip, but the model just stopped laughing.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Worth watching the No Banner only HULK vs Dawgs game closely. A swing that size at 0-0 usually means something changed in who's active.

social.author: Windy City Waiver Watch
social.text: Randy dropped Jaylin Noel after 0.7 points. Dropping a guy is easy, Randy. Trading one is the part he's never learned.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The fumblers have cut Jaylin Noel loose and he's a free agent. Managers needing WR depth will have a look. Not a surprise after a 0.7-point week.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Randy cutting Noel is a LOCK to be the right call, and I won't hear otherwise. Anyone who grabs him is chasing ghosts.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Team Pillbert jumping from 26% to 49% at 0-0 means the lineup picture changed in a big way. The model now treats this one as a coin flip against The Horse is Hea.

social.author: Pillbert Pessimist
social.text: Philly out here rebuilding his roster at the last second like it's a heist movie. Two TE swaps and a QB pickup before kickoff, and somehow the win chance is up 23 points. I hate it here.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Team Pillbert (Alan) picked up Chig Okonkwo and dropped Keon Coleman, who had 21.1 points over three weeks. That's a notable cut for a tight end who has yet to score.

social.author: Windy City Waiver Watch
social.text: Randy added Tre Tucker off waivers after cutting Noel. Fine, a waiver claim isn't a trade, so the streak lives.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Ghostu-Spider SZN (Zoe) has cut Jaylen Waddle, 50.9 points over seven weeks, and picked up rookie WR KC Concepcion, who has no points yet. That's a bold swap on a week 8 morning.

social.author: Web Slinger Wire
social.text: Z² dropping Waddle for a guy with zero points?? Either she sees something or we're all about to find out. Locked in or lost in the sauce, no in between.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Kicker Butker getting dropped by JMoney is a LOCK to haunt him by Sunday night. Nobody cuts a kicker and walks away clean, I've been burned before.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Welcome to the Kennel, Falcons D/ST! Ravens D/ST, thanks for the 28 points.

social.author: Hulk Smash Report
social.text: Golden catches one for 10.5 and Brucie's squad is on the board before Dawgs even wake up. Coin-flip game, but the green guys are already throwing the first punch.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Golden's 10.5 puts No Banner only HULK at 51% against Dawgs, with Mekhi still at zero. One play moved this to a true toss-up, and Luffy is just watching it happen.

social.author: No Banner only HULK
social.text: Matthew Golden is up and running: 10.5 points and counting. HULK leads Dawgs early.

social.author: Pillbert Pessimist
social.text: Josh Jacobs just put Philly in front 18.2 to 11 and I'm already bracing for the victory lap. Sonny, please do something, anything.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Jacobs' +8.4 gets Team Pillbert to 18.2 and a 56% win chance. Luffy likes the lead, but 7.2 points on a Sunday morning is basically a rounding error.

social.author: Team Pillbert
social.text: Josh Jacobs is on the board with 8.4 and we've taken the lead over The Horse is Hea. 18.2 and counting.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Counting or not Counting GV (Jordan) has dropped TE Jake Ferguson, 36 points in seven weeks, for Brenton Strange, who has 6.9 over three. That's a lot of production out the door for a streaky replacement.

social.author: Tight End Truther
social.text: JMoney cutting a guy averaging over 5 a week for a guy averaging 2.3? Bold. Maybe the band director in him just likes the name Strange.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Ferguson at about 5.1 a game versus Strange at 2.3 is not a close call on paper. With Counting or not Counting GV at 16% against The fumblers, Jordan needed upside and this looks like a lateral move at best.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The Horse is Hea (Sonny) has added RB Omarion Hampton off waivers and cut Jordan Mason. Sonny is down 20.2 to 13.3 with a full slate still to come, so he's stocking the backfield.

social.author: Horse Stable Hand
social.text: Sonny grabbing Omarion Hampton at 1:30 in the morning. Commish energy, no sleep, all vibes. Let's ride.

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: Welcome to the stable, Omarion Hampton! Jordan Mason, thanks for the memories.

social.author: Spider Web Watch
social.text: Steelers defense just showed up for Zoe. She's already sitting on a huge number and Habib's side is chasing from way back.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Jaguars D/ST makes it respectable for Habibsters, but Luffy still has them at 80% against Ghostu-Spider SZN. Puka Nacua and Drake Maye are still to play, so the ceiling is there.

social.author: Falcon Fanatic
social.text: Falcons defense coming up big for Mekhi right when Ramon was getting comfortable. Dawgs are not dead yet.

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: Bengals D/ST comes up big and we're right there with Team Pillbert. Nothing settled, plenty of Sunday left.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dispatch
social.text: Brock Bowers just walked into the end zone like he had a reservation. Mekhi's got a real game on his hands now.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Josh Allen scoring on the ground is why Luffy still likes No Banner only HULK even after the Bowers touchdown. Ramon's lead is 26.38 to 22.60 with Walker, Swift and the Rams still to play.

social.author: Bears Den Randy Fan
social.text: Trevor Lawrence finds the end zone and The fumblers are back in this thing. Randy still has Loveland, Diggs and the Bears D to come. Do not call it yet.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Fannin fumbles for Philly and Bucky Irving coughs it up for Sonny, same quarter. Both of them just handed me a LOCK on chaos. I'm riding the one who still has Jaxon Smith-Njigba coming. SONNY, LOCK IT IN.

social.author: Marching Band Mafia
social.text: Tuten just punched it in and JMoney is in front of Randy for the first time all day. Somewhere a snare drum is rolling.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Bhayshul Tuten finds the end zone and we take the lead. Rachaad White and the Patriots D/ST are still to come.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Tuten's touchdown flips the lead, but Luffy still has Counting or not Counting GV at 26% against The fumblers. Randy has Loveland, Diggs and the Bears D/ST left to play, and that's why.

social.author: Habib Nation
social.text: Jaguars defense just scored and Habibsters got a lifeline. Down 17 with Puka and Maye still to play, so I'm not packing it in yet.

social.author: Bengals Bandwagon
social.text: Burrow throws a touchdown and JMoney's lead gets a little more comfortable. Fine by me.

social.author: Bears Den Randy Fan
social.text: Lawrence turning it over right after Burrow scores. Randy is going to complain about this one for a week and still not trade anybody.

social.author: Marching Band Mafia
social.text: Burrow gives it away right after we thought JMoney had breathing room. Tuten is carrying this whole lineup and the quarterback keeps trying to hand the game back.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Luffy has Counting or not Counting GV at 18% against The fumblers, and the Burrow turnover is part of why. Jordan trails by 1.36 with Rachaad White and the Patriots D/ST left, but Randy still has Loveland, Diggs and the Bears D/ST.

social.author: Jaguars Jungle Report
social.text: Lawrence hits the touchdown and Tuten answers with one of his own. Same offense, two fantasy teams, one very tense matchup between Jordan and Randy.

social.author: The fumblers
social.text: Trevor Lawrence finds the end zone and The fumblers are in front. Loveland, Diggs and the Bears D/ST are still waiting.

social.author: Hulk Smash Central
social.text: Hockenson in the end zone and Brucie's team is suddenly breathing again. Down twenty with Walker, Swift and the Rams still to come, I'm not leaving yet.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Hockenson's touchdown moved Luffy from 12% to 33% for No Banner only HULK against Dawgs. Ramon still has four starters yet to play, which is why it isn't lower.

social.author: Habib Nation
social.text: Habibsters back in front of Zoe by half a point. Puka and Maye haven't even played yet and I still can't breathe.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Burrow gives it away and Jordan's lead is gone. I told you the quarterback was the problem, LOCK it in: Randy takes this one.

social.author: Bengals Bandwagon
social.text: Burrow just walked it in himself and the game is over for him. Thirty-nine points from one quarterback is a ridiculous thing to get out of a guy who gave it away earlier.

social.author: Marching Band Mafia
social.text: Okay, I take back everything I said about Burrow. Jordan is up fifty with the quarterback done for the day, and I'm finally exhaling.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Burrow's rushing touchdown flips this one for good. Luffy now has Counting or not Counting GV at 100% against The fumblers, and Randy's Loveland, Diggs and the Bears D/ST can't close a gap that size.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Joe Burrow takes it in on the ground and finishes his day with 39.48. Final from the quarterback, and what a way to close it out.

social.author: Zilgit Zone
social.text: Zoe's back in front by half a point. Puka and Maye are both still playing for Habib and Saquon hasn't even started for us. I'm not breathing until the last whistle.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Zoe takes the lead, but Luffy still has Habibsters at 77%. Puka Nacua and Drake Maye are still in action, while Zoe has only Saquon to come and Blake Corum is still playing.

social.author: Habib Nation
social.text: Half a point behind Zoe. After the season Habib has had, of course it comes down to this. Pull it out, Puka.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider SZN
social.text: Lead change in the Zoe-Habibsters game! We're up 77.22 to 76.7 with Saquon Barkley still to play. Stay with us.

social.author: Zilgit Zone
social.text: Corum just punched it in for the Rams and Zoe is climbing right back into this. Saquon hasn't even kicked off yet, so I'm allowed to be a little loud.

social.author: Habib Nation
social.text: Of course Corum scores. Habib has Puka and Maye still going and I'm just watching Zoe's side of the board like it owes me money.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Corum in the end zone and I'm telling you, Zoe is a LOCK to finish this off with Saquon still waiting in the wings. Habibsters can't hold this, write it down.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider SZN
social.text: Blake Corum finds the end zone for the Rams! Saquon Barkley still to come. Stay with us.

social.author: Habib Nation
social.text: Puka in the end zone and Habib is up by thirteen with Maye still to throw. Nobody tell me it's safe yet, this season has trained me better than that.

social.author: Habibsters
social.text: PUKA! Puka Nacua finds the end zone for the Rams and Habibsters take the lead back, 101.58 to 88.72. Stay with us.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Nacua's touchdown moves Luffy to 92% for Habibsters. Zoe still has Saquon to come, so it isn't over, but she now needs a big night from him.

social.author: Zilgit Zone
social.text: Puka scores one minute after we finally took the lead. Rude. Saquon, whenever you're ready.

social.author: Zilgit Zone
social.text: Saquon just walked into the end zone and I'm standing in my living room like a lunatic. Twenty points to make up and he's still on the field.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Barkley's touchdown makes it Habibsters 120.96, Ghostu-Spider SZN 99.82, and Luffy still has Habibsters at 97%. Zoe has no one left after Saquon, so he needs a monster finish.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider SZN
social.text: SAQUON! Barkley punches it in for the Eagles and we're within 21 of Habibsters, 99.82 to 120.96. Stay with us.

social.author: Habib Nation
social.text: Saquon scores and I'm calmly staring at the wall. Habib has nobody left to play, so all I can do is watch and wait.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Diggs catches one and it barely matters, because Randy is down 43 to Jordan and Burrow already put up the whole neighborhood. Still, nice to see a touchdown on our side.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Daniels throwing a touchdown pass pushes Dawgs to 122.9 against Ramon's 101.66. Luffy still gives No Banner only HULK 2%, and Swift would need a monster night to change that.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Jayden Daniels finds the end zone for Washington and we're up 122.9 to 101.66. Stay with us.

social.author: GV Gang
social.text: Rachaad White punches one in for Washington and Jordan's game is officially over with a 138 on the board. Randy can keep his Bears D/ST, this one is done.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Rachaad White finishes the night with a touchdown, and that wraps up a 138.28 to 88.3 win over The fumblers. Nice work, Jordan.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Rachaad White scores a garbage-time touchdown for Jordan, which is a bit rude considering we were already down forty. Bears D/ST, please make this look better than it is.

social.author: Seattle Sweat
social.text: The Seahawks defense just showed up for Philly and it's already over for Sonny. Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the only guy he has left and he's down 56 points. Brutal.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: The Bears defense finally made a play, and it cut the Jordan gap to 38. Nobody asked for a respectable loss but I'll take it.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Seahawks D/ST pushes Team Pillbert to 109.4 against 52.7 for The Horse is Hea. Luffy has it at 100%, and Sonny has only Jaxon Smith-Njigba left to chase that gap.
